rules.note_2027: NBA release, May 28, 2026: three balls for teams outside the playoffs and play-in, the three worst records "draft relegated" to two, No. 9 and 10 play-in seeds two, losers of 7 vs 8 one; all 16 drawn; relegated teams no lower than No. 12; no team's pick first in two consecutive drafts. In effect 2027-2029 (NBA explainer); 2030 on is for a Board of Governors vote, so those years use these rules, flagged.
